beratung.anliegen.bauch-nach-schwangersc: If skin is left over and the rectus abdominis muscles have drifted apart, no amount of training changes that. If only individual fat deposits are the problem and the skin is firm, liposuction is the smaller procedure. The precondition for both: a stable weight and completed family planning.
My belly has not come back after pregnancy
beratung.anliegen.blick-muede.text: The decisive difference: is it the eyelid or the brow? A simple hint — lift the brow gently with your finger. If the eye already looks awake then, the brow is the issue, and an eyelid lift would be the wrong procedure.
beratung.anliegen.brust.text: Two different questions: is volume missing, or have the breasts dropped? An enlargement creates volume but no lift; a lift creates shape but no volume. Anyone who wants both needs both — with correspondingly more effort and more risk.
beratung.anliegen.falten-mimik.text: Lines that appear when you speak and laugh come from the muscle underneath. Lines that remain in a relaxed face come from the skin. Botox is meant for the one, fillers or laser for the other. That distinction belongs at the beginning of a consultation, not at the end.
beratung.anliegen.falten-mimik.titel: My frown and forehead lines bother me
beratung.anliegen.fettpolster.text: If the rest of the body responds to exercise and diet and one spot does not, it is a question of shape, not of weight. None of these procedures helps with losing weight — and anyone who comes with that expectation risks having too much done.
beratung.anliegen.fettpolster.titel: Individual fat deposits will not go away
beratung.anliegen.geheimratsecken.text: The first question is whether hair roots are still there. Where they are weakened, treatments without surgery come into question; where they are missing, only a transplant helps. The two do not exclude each other — and with hereditary hair loss, what slows the further loss should be discussed at the same time.
beratung.anliegen.haar-frauen.text: Hair loss in women is more often diffuse than in men, and it often has a treatable cause: iron, thyroid, hormones, medication. That is why a work-up belongs before any transplant — otherwise one is transplanting into an ongoing process.
beratung.anliegen.haut-muede.text: If the issue is not the oval of the face but the surface — glow, texture, pores, fine crinkly lines — then it is a question of skin quality. Other procedures apply to that than to sagging, and they usually require several sessions.
beratung.anliegen.haut-muede.titel: My skin looks tired and dull
beratung.anliegen.koerperbehaarung.text: Laser works through the pigment in the hair. Dark hair responds well, light, red and grey hair barely at all. It is a lasting reduction of hair, not lasting freedom from hair — and it needs six to ten sessions.
beratung.anliegen.nase.text: Is it a hump, a deviation or the tip — and do you breathe well? Small irregularities can be evened out with filler without surgery, to a limited extent and for a limited time. Everything beyond that, and especially everything to do with breathing, is a surgical procedure.
beratung.anliegen.oval-sackt-ab.text: A jawline losing definition, sunken cheeks, the beginning of jowls: here the degree decides. With the onset of sagging, procedures without surgery come into question; with pronounced excess skin a facelift is the honest answer — anything else would be money for one year.
beratung.anliegen.oval-sackt-ab.titel: The oval of my face is dropping
beratung.anliegen.volumen-fehlt.text: Volume is lost over the years — in the cheeks, at the temples, under the eyes. Fillers give it back. The most common mistake here is too much: a padded face looks older, not younger.
beratung.anliegen.zaehne.text: Too dark, chipped, crooked, or all of that together? If the teeth are healthy and merely discoloured, a whitening is enough and costs no tooth substance. If they are healthy but crooked, orthodontic treatment is gentler. Only when substance is missing are veneers or crowns the right answer — and what is ground away does not come back.
beratung.anliegen.zaehne.titel: I do not like showing my teeth
beratung.vergleich.haartransplantation-h: All four are variants of the same basic method: individual extraction from the ring of hair, placement in the thinning area. The difference lies in the tool. Sapphire concerns the blade with which the channels are opened; DHI concerns the pen with which the hair is placed. Roughly: classic FUE for large areas, DHI for the hairline and for densifying between existing hair. Anyone who sells you one of the variants as generally the better one without looking at your findings is selling, not advising. The figure by which you compare quotations is called the same in all four cases: grafts.
FUE, DHI, sapphire and percutaneous compared
beratung.vergleich.haut-beauty-straffung: All four tighten without surgery, but they do different things. HIFU works over an area through newly formed collagen, without downtime, building up slowly over two to three months. Threads lift mechanically and work at once, but cost a few days of swelling. Radiofrequency with microneedling additionally targets skin quality. Mesolifting is above all moisture and only tightens to a limited degree. None of them replaces a facelift where there is pronounced excess skin — that is the sentence a consultation has to say when it applies.
HIFU, threads, radiofrequency and mesolifting compared
beratung.vergleich.plastische-chirurgie-: Volume and shape are two different questions. An implant gives volume and usually lasts ten to fifteen years — count on a replacement. Own fat works without foreign material, but only by a scant cup size per session, and part of it is broken down again. A lift raises and shapes, but does not fill.
Enlargement, lift and own fat compared

The question is not how much fat should go, but how well the skin retracts. If it is firm, suction is enough. If it has slackened, suction leaves an empty shell, and the right answer is a tightening — with a scar. Both procedures call for a stable weight, and both carry the highest risk of thrombosis in this catalogue.
beratung.vergleich.zaehne-zahnaesthetik-: Sorted by how much tooth substance you lose in the process: a whitening costs none. A veneer costs a little enamel. A crown requires the tooth to be ground down all round — and that is final. An implant replaces a tooth that is already missing. With every package offer, ask whether veneers or crowns are planned; many offers work with crowns to save time, and the difference is considerable.
Whitening, veneers, crowns and implants compared

glossar.abdominoplastik.kurz: The technical term for a tummy tuck.
glossar.abdominoplastik.lang: The surgical removal of excess skin and fatty tissue on the lower abdomen, almost always combined with stitching together the rectus muscles that have drifted apart.
glossar.blepharoplastik.kurz: The technical term for an eyelid lift.
glossar.blepharoplastik.lang: The surgical removal of excess skin or bulging fatty tissue on the upper or lower eyelids.
glossar.botulinumtoxin.lang: A protein which, injected into a muscle in a very small amount, blocks the signal from the nerve to the muscle for a few months. «Botox» is a brand name, not the name of the substance.
glossar.choi-stift.kurz: Implanter pen with a hollow needle for the DHI technique.
glossar.choi-stift.lang: A pen-shaped instrument with a very fine hollow needle. The graft is loaded into it; the needle opens the channel and pushes the hair in with the same movement. Named after the clinic in South Korea where the technique was developed.
glossar.dhi.kurz: Direct Hair Implantation: placement with the Choi pen.
glossar.dhi.lang: A variant of FUE. Extraction is the same; the difference lies in the placement. Instead of first opening channels and then laying grafts into them, the hair is introduced with a Choi pen in a single movement. Advantage: angle, direction and depth can be determined for every hair, and less shaving is needed. Disadvantage: it takes longer, so on very large areas fewer grafts per session are often possible.
glossar.eswt.lang: Treatment with pressure waves applied from outside, without surgery. Well studied for individual applications — in orthopaedics, for instance — but not for other indications.
glossar.fue.kurz: Follicular Unit Extraction: individual extraction of the hair roots.
glossar.fue.lang: The standard method of hair transplantation today. Individual grafts are released from the ring of hair at the back of the head with a hollow needle of less than a millimetre — in contrast to the older strip method, in which a strip of skin was removed and left a long scar. With FUE many tiny, dot-shaped scars arise instead.
glossar.graft.kurz: One extracted unit of one to four hair roots.
glossar.graft.lang: In a hair transplant it is not single hairs that are transplanted but the natural unit in which hair grows: a graft of one to four hair roots. The number of grafts is the quantity by which hair transplants are usually billed — so always ask for it when you compare quotations. A figure in a quotation without a graft count is not comparable.
glossar.hifu.lang: A handpiece focuses ultrasound energy at a precisely defined depth beneath the skin — 1.5, 3 or 4.5 millimetres, depending on the tip. Dot-shaped heated zones arise there which contract the tissue and set the formation of new collagen in motion. The surface of the skin stays uninjured, which is why there is no downtime. The effect builds up over two to three months.
glossar.hyaluronidase.kurz: Antidote that dissolves hyaluronic acid fillers.
glossar.hyaluronidase.lang: An enzyme that breaks down injected hyaluronic acid within one to two days. It is at the same time the emergency remedy when a vessel is blocked by filler. Ask before any injection whether it is kept in stock at the practice — a good practice finds the question right, not awkward.
glossar.injektionslipolyse.lang: A solution of active substances is injected into small fat deposits. In Switzerland the preparations are not authorised as medicinal products for this application, and the effect cannot be demonstrated in everyone treated. Reckon with several days of marked swelling.
glossar.kapselfibrose.kurz: Hardening of the connective tissue capsule around a breast implant.
glossar.kapselfibrose.lang: The body encloses every implant in a capsule of connective tissue — that is normal. If this capsule contracts and hardens, the breast becomes firm, may hurt and change shape. It is the most common late complication with breast implants; it can occur years after the procedure, and the treatment is another operation.
glossar.krone.kurz: A cap that encloses the whole tooth.
glossar.krone.lang: A crown becomes necessary when a tooth is badly damaged, heavily filled or root-treated. For this the tooth has to be ground down all round — and what has been removed does not come back; the tooth needs a restoration permanently.
glossar.kryolipolyse.lang: Fatty tissue is cooled in a controlled way over a longer period. Fat cells react more sensitively to cold than the surrounding skin. A procedure for small, clearly defined deposits at a stable weight, not a means of losing weight.
glossar.liposuktion.kurz: The technical term for fat suction.
glossar.liposuktion.lang: The suctioning of fatty tissue through small incisions with fine cannulas. A procedure for shaping, not for losing weight.
glossar.masseter.kurz: The chewing muscle at the angle of the jaw.
glossar.masseter.lang: The strong muscle that stands out at the angle of the jaw when you bite down. If it is relaxed with botulinum toxin, teeth grinding eases and the face can appear narrower. The effect lasts a few months.
glossar.mastopexie.kurz: The technical term for a breast lift.
glossar.mastopexie.lang: The surgical removal of excess skin with the nipple and areola set higher. It gives shape, but no volume.
glossar.otoplastik.kurz: The technical term for ear correction.
glossar.otoplastik.lang: The surgical shaping of the ear cartilage through an incision behind the ear, usually to lay back protruding ears.
glossar.periimplantitis.kurz: Inflammation of the bone around a dental implant.
glossar.periimplantitis.lang: The most common cause of losing an implant. It runs more quietly than an inflammation at a real tooth, because the implant itself cannot hurt — which is why regular check-ups are not a recommendation but the condition for the implant to last.
glossar.perkutane-technik.kurz: Opening the channels with a round needle instead of a blade.
glossar.perkutane-technik.lang: A further variant of channel opening in hair transplantation: instead of a slit, a round hole is pierced with a round needle. The aim is a more natural direction of growth and a denser arrangement.
glossar.polynukleotide.kurz: Purified fragments of genetic material, mostly from salmon milt.
glossar.polynukleotide.lang: They are introduced into the skin as a gel on the idea that they bind moisture and stimulate the skin cells. Robust evidence for a particular aesthetic effect is lacking, and preparations of this kind are not authorised as medicinal products for this application in Switzerland. Not suitable if a fish allergy is known.
glossar.prp.kurz: Platelet-rich plasma from your own blood.
glossar.prp.lang: Blood is drawn and centrifuged so that the plasma fraction with a high concentration of platelets remains; this is introduced into the skin or the scalp. The evidence for aesthetic applications is inconsistent, and some of those treated do not respond.
glossar.rektusdiastase.kurz: Rectus abdominis muscles that have drifted apart.
glossar.rektusdiastase.lang: After pregnancies or a strong gain in weight the two rectus abdominis muscles drift apart in the middle. That is the reason the belly protrudes despite training, and training alone usually does not reverse it. In an abdominoplasty the muscles are brought back together.
glossar.rhinoplastik.kurz: The technical term for nose correction.
glossar.rhinoplastik.lang: The surgical reshaping of the nose. If the nasal septum is straightened at the same time, it is called a septorhinoplasty — that is the case when breathing, and not only shape, is an issue.
glossar.saphir-fue.kurz: FUE with blades of synthetic sapphire.
glossar.saphir-fue.lang: Not a method of its own but a different tool within FUE: the receiving channels are opened with sapphire rather than steel blades. These taper to a point and create a V-shaped instead of a U-shaped opening — the wound is smaller and the channels can be set closer together. The blade does not, however, make the hairline; the person operating does.
glossar.scarlet-x.kurz: A device name for microneedling with radiofrequency.
glossar.scarlet-x.lang: Not a procedure of its own but a device name. Fine needles bring radiofrequency energy into the skin in order to stimulate the formation of collagen.
glossar.serom.kurz: A collection of wound fluid under the skin.
glossar.serom.lang: After larger procedures, particularly after abdominoplasties and liposuction, wound fluid can collect. It often has to be drawn off with a needle several times. Common and as a rule easy to treat — but a reason not to book the return flight too early.
glossar.shock-loss.kurz: Temporary hair loss after a transplant.
glossar.shock-loss.lang: After a hair transplant the transplanted hairs fall out after two to four weeks, and existing hair in the treated area often thins temporarily as well. This alarms many people, but it is part of the normal course: the root stays, and from about the third month it grows back.
glossar.skinbooster.kurz: Fine hyaluronic depots for skin moisture.
glossar.skinbooster.lang: Unlike a shaping filler, no volume is built up here; instead hyaluronic acid is distributed finely over an area in order to bind moisture. Its tightening effect is limited.
glossar.smas.kurz: The connective tissue and muscle layer beneath the facial skin.
glossar.smas.lang: Short for «superficial musculoaponeurotic system». In a modern facelift it is not only skin that is tightened — that was the technique of earlier decades and the reason for the mask-like expression many people have in mind. Instead this underlying layer is lifted and fixed; the skin is only laid over it afterwards, without tension. Before a facelift, ask what holds the tension: the skin or the SMAS.
glossar.tumeszenz.kurz: Anaesthetic fluid that loosens the fatty tissue.
glossar.tumeszenz.lang: Before liposuction a large quantity of a solution is introduced into the fatty tissue which loosens it, narrows the vessels and numbs the region. This reduces blood loss and pain.
glossar.vaskulaere-okklusion.kurz: Blockage of a blood vessel by filler material.
glossar.vaskulaere-okklusion.lang: The most serious complication with injections: the filler gets into a vessel and interrupts the blood supply. Warning signs are severe pain, whitening or blotchy, net-like discolouration of the skin — with injections around the nose and eyes also a sudden disturbance of vision. This is an emergency: go straight back to the practice or to an emergency department. Treatable if you are quick.
glossar.veneer.kurz: A thin ceramic shell on the visible surface of a tooth.
glossar.veneer.lang: For a veneer only a little enamel is removed from the front of the tooth. That is the decisive difference from a crown, which encloses the whole tooth and calls for substantial grinding all round. For a largely healthy tooth the veneer is the gentler choice.
